svg.title: Remi menu bar icon concepts, comparison sheet
svg.desc: Every direction and state, light and dark menu bars side by side, drawn at 2x (36 px icon canvas; 18 pt). The real "r" comes from r-mask.png. Concept art, not shipping assets.

text.font-family: -apple-system, SF Pro Text, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remi menu bar status icon: concepts A to E

text.font-family: -apple-system, SF Pro Text, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 36 px = 18 pt at 2x. Each cell: light bar | dark bar. Recommended: E.
